verdict.rationale: The evidence pack says only that Fly.io uses pay-as-you-go billing for compute, storage and bandwidth, and that disk is billed by bytes written. It contains no published rate card, per-unit prices, or overage fee schedule that would let a devops lead know exact charges before billing. Pricing transparency is a fair axis for a cloud platform, so the missing evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the exact overage fee schedule for exceeding plan usage limits (bandwidth, invocations, build minutes) before I get billed
